package com.acme.model;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Function;
import static java.util.Collections.emptyList;
import static com.acme.service.Registry.lookup;
import com.acme.service.Registry;

/**
 * A shape. Javadoc is not extracted.
 */
public abstract sealed class Shape<T extends Comparable<T>> extends Base implements Comparable<Shape<T>>, Named, java.io.Serializable
        permits Circle, Square {

    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    protected Map<String, List<Point>> points = new HashMap<>();
    private Optional<Owner> owner;
    @Nullable private Owner backup;
    @Deprecated
    public Settings settings;
    private OwnerService ownerService;
    int a, b;
    private Point[] corners;
    private Map.Entry<String, Point> entry;
    String publicKey;
    private List<? extends Point> wild;

    public Shape() {
        this(0);
    }

    public Shape(int sides, String... names) {
        super(sides);
        Point p = new Point(1, 2);
        p.move(3);
        var q = new Point(0, 0);
        q.move(1);
        List<Point> copies = new ArrayList<>();
        copies.add(p);
        ownerService.find(sides);
        class Local {
            void helper() { Registry.lookup("x"); }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(Shape<T> other) {
        return Integer.compare(area(), other.area());
    }

    @Override
    public String name() { return "shape"; }

    public abstract double area();

    public double area(int scale) { return area() * scale; }

    public double area(double scale, Point origin) { return area() * scale; }

    protected <R> List<R> map(Function<? super Shape<T>, ? extends R> f, Map<String, Owner> index) {
        Runnable r = () -> lookup("lambda");
        Function<String, Integer> len = String::length;
        Comparator<Point> cmp = new Comparator<Point>() {
            @Override
            public int compare(Point x, Point y) { return x.compareTo(y); }
        };
        new Thread(new Runnable() {
            public void run() { this.helper().done(); }
        }).start();
        return emptyList();
    }

    public static Shape<?> of(final String kind) {
        switch (kind) {
            case "c" -> { return new Circle(1.0); }
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Ünknown kind: " + kind);
        }
    }

    public Point[] cornerArray() { return corners; }
    public int[] counts() { return null; }
    public Map.Entry<String, Point> firstEntry() { return entry; }
    public void name(String n) {}

    static class Inner extends Shape<Integer> {
        @Override
        public double area() { return 0; }
        class Deeper { Inner up() { return Inner.this; } }
    }

    public enum Kind implements Named {
        CIRCLE { @Override public String name2() { return "c"; } },
        SQUARE;
        private final int code = 1;
        Kind() {}
        public String name2() { return name(); }
    }
}
